# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-first portrait browser game called **Volt Ring Rush**. Preserve the source endless-runner mechanics: three lanes, swipe/arrow lane changes, swipe/arrow-up jump, accelerating forward speed, distance score, +500 collectible bonus, same-lane obstacle collision failure, game-over score, and restart. Reinterpret the presentation as a Sonic-inspired neon arcade loop runner: a blue speedster mascot races along glowing rails, collects golden rings, vaults hot-pink spike gates, and sees Boost Heat rise over time. Use a single self-contained index.html with inline Canvas, CSS, and JavaScript. Favor procedural browser-native art, animated loop motifs, readable portrait HUD, large tappable CTAs, and compact non-blocking feedback media.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile-first canvas endless runner with three lanes, forward projection, obstacle avoidance, jump dodging, score accumulation, bonus pickups, and restart.
- objective: Survive as long as possible while score increases by distance/speed; collect bonus pickups for +500 score.
- input model: Pointer/touch swipe left/right changes between lanes -1/0/1; swipe up or ArrowUp jumps; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight lane changes; start and restart are button clicks/taps.
- core loop: Start run, accelerate gradually, spawn forward objects, move objects toward player, update score, process collision against lane/Z/jump height, render perspective grid and entities, end on obstacle hit, restart.
- fail/friction state: Obstacle collision in the same lane near player Z while not high enough in jump triggers game over and final score modal.

## Protected mechanics
- Three-lane movement with the same lane bounds and smooth interpolation.
- Swipe and keyboard controls: horizontal lane changes, upward jump, no global UI tap suppression.
- Acceleration, distance score, bonus pickup score, moving grid, object spawn cadence, collision window, jump-over safety threshold, game-over/restart loop.
- Canvas-based active playfield and HUD score updates.

## Remixed target
Volt Ring Rush reinterprets the runner as a Sonic-inspired neon arcade speed trial: a blue rebel speedster blasts down glow rails, gathers golden rings, vaults pink spike gates, and chases boost heat through loop-heavy procedural scenery. The public surface is rebuilt in a single inline HTML/CSS/JS file, with the legacy game preserved as index_old.html for reference only.
